newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas to sign gas deal with Exxon unit.
newsitem.headline: Petronas to sign gas deal with Exxon unit.

text.p: Malaysian national oil firm Petronas on Friday said that it will sign an agreement on a new gas production-sharing contract with a unit of Exxon Corp on Monday.

"Petronas is pleased to inform that it has reached an agreement with Esso Production Malaysia and Petronas Carigali Sdn Bhd on the main terms of a new gas production-sharing contract," a statement by Petroliam Nasional (Petronas) said.

The agreement will be signed by Petronas president and chief executive Hassan Marican; Philip Dingle, Esso Production chairman and chief executive of Esso Companies in Malaysia; and Petronas Carigali's managing director and chief executive Mohamad Idris Mansor.
Exxon's chairman and chief executive, Lee Raymond will also be present, said the statement.
A Petronas spokesman declined to provide details of the agreement. Esso could not be immediately contacted.
